title: We invite MogaDisco onto Colpey Calling x The Fix with a guest mix
content:
24th August 2015

This week we welcomed MogaDisco, the London-based collective with a passion for African music. We first heard about MogaDisco when we had Bristol’s Hi Life Hi Fi on the show – following the great success of that mix, we knew we just had to get them in with a guest mix of their own. Luckily, they didn’t disappoint. Manu Dibango, The Cannibals, Amara Toure – this mix had it all. Enjoy.

 

 
 

Tracklist

Colpey Calling

  • Maalem Mahmoud Guinia & Floating Points – ‘Mimoun Marhaba’
  • Amara Touré – ‘N’Niyo’
  • Ebo Taylor – ‘Nga Nga’ 
  • No Go Stop – ‘Animal’
  • Teaspoon & the Waves -‘ Oh Yea Soweto’ 

MogaDisco

  • Cst Amankwah – ‘Yewo Ayie Mu’
  • Paulson Kalu Afrikhanah and His Stars 25 – ‘Ochea Special’
  • Amara Toure (feat L’Orchestre  Massako) – ‘Tela’
  • Number One de Dakar – ‘Yaye Boye’
  • La Tromba – ‘Calaba Calabao’
  • The Cannibals – ‘We Keep On Keeping On’
  • Danny Offia & The Friks – ‘Funk With Me’
  • Joe Masunga – ‘Nwananga Washaneseka’
  • Manu Dibango – ‘Electric Africa’
  • Analog Players Society – ‘Coule’Ba’ (JKriv Version)

Colpey Calling

  • Ata Kak – ‘Obaa Sima’
  • Basa Basa – ‘African Soul Power’
  • Anchorsong – ‘Ivory’
  • Dur Dur Band – ‘Doyoo’
  • Habu Ley – ‘Haffi Deo’
  • Jay-U – ‘Experience Some More’
  • Tchero Adari Nègn – ‘Alèmayèhu Eshèté’
  • Mahmoud Ahmed – ‘Mètché Nèw’
